_description: The `rate_limit` list of one provider instance, exactly as the settings document stores it and as `GET /chat/providers/{id}` returns it. Each entry is one limit: `kind` (requests | tokens | budget_usd), `window` (a unit name, or {"rolling": seconds}), `calendar` (the time zone of a day/week/month window: "utc" or an IANA name; null otherwise), `max` (strictly positive, a whole number for requests and tokens) and `scope` ("instance", {"credential": "<credential_ref>"} or {"model": "<id>"}). A credential is named by its REFERENCE (vault:<name>, env:<VAR>) and never by a value. The list is optional: an instance without it behaves exactly as before the field existed.
